summary: Completed backend testing of Fase 4.1 and 4.2 - Auditoría Operativa de Compras. All 30 tests passed (100%). Detector de pedidos, bitácora, pedidos procesados, tareas operativas, KPIs, and automatizaciones endpoints all working correctly.

minor.issue: Some legacy records have server_id instead of empresa_id (expected - Fase 4.1 is new)

critical_code_review_comments: Detector de pedidos job correctly registered in scheduler_manager.py with 5-minute interval
Anti-duplicado system working via pedidos_procesados_automatizacion collection
Bitácora properly logs all detector events (EJECUCION_COMPLETADA, TAREA_CREADA, etc.)
Tareas operativas correctly created with CAPTURA_INVENTARIO type and PENDIENTE estado
All endpoints properly protected with JWT authentication
empresa_id used as primary key for Unidad de Negocio (server_id only for internal use)
SQL servers not accessible from pod (expected) - system handles gracefully with 0 pedidos_detectados
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Existing data: 8 automatizaciones, 2 pedidos procesados, 1 tarea operativa
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fase 4.1 and 4.2 backend fully tested. Key findings: 1) POST /detector/ejecutar executes manual detection - returns estadisticas with empresas_procesadas, pedidos_detectados, etc. 2) GET /detector/estado shows job info and ultima_ejecucion. 3) GET /detector/bitacora returns eventos with job, evento, fecha fields. 4) GET /pedidos-procesados returns anti-duplicado records (empresa_id, pedido_folio, origen). 5) GET /tareas returns CAPTURA_INVENTARIO tasks with empresa context. 6) GET /kpis and GET /compras work with filters. 7) SQL servers not accessible from pod - expected behavior, system handles gracefully.

POST_detector_ejecutar.details: Manual execution works. Returns success=true with estadisticas (empresas_procesadas, servidores_consultados, pedidos_detectados, etc.)

GET_detector_bitacora.details: Returns eventos list with id, job, evento, datos, fecha. Respects limite parameter

GET_pedidos_procesados.details: Returns pedidos list with folio, origen, fecha_procesado. Filters by empresa_id and estado work

GET_tareas.details: Returns tareas list with tipo=CAPTURA_INVENTARIO, estado, empresa context. Filters work

GET_tareas_id.details: Returns 404 for nonexistent tarea, 200 with full details for existing

GET_kpis.details: Returns KPIs dict. Accepts server_id filter

GET_compras.details: Returns automatizaciones list. Filters by estado, sucursal_id, limite work

GET_compras_id.details: Returns 404 for nonexistent, 200 with details for existing

authentication.details: All endpoints require Bearer token. Returns 401/403 without auth

mocked_integrations.note: No mocked APIs. SQL servers not accessible from pod (expected) - detector handles gracefully
